files.description: Specific files to include in the project.

include.description: Glob patterns for files to include.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude.

ExtendsFieldJson.description: Value for the "extends" field of a dsconfig.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for resolving non-relative module names.

paths.description: Path alias mappings (resolved relative to baseUrl, like tsconfig paths).

profile.description: Default profile for IDEs and CLI usage.

comptimeEnv.description: Comptime environment whitelist (if omitted, all env keys are visible).

incremental.description: Enable incremental compilation for this project.

strict.description: Enable all strict type checking options. Default: true for .ds files.

noImplicitAny.description: Error on expressions and declarations with implied `any` type.

strictNullChecks.description: Enable strict null checks (`null` and `undefined` are distinct types).

noImplicitThis.description: Error on `this` expressions with implied `any` type.

strictFunctionTypes.description: Enable strict checking of function types.

strictBindCallApply.description: Enable strict checking of `bind`, `call`, and `apply` methods.

strictBuiltinIteratorReturn.description: Enable strict checking for built in iterator return types.

strictPropertyInitialization.description: Enable strict checking of property initialization in classes.

useUnknownInCatchVariables.description: Use `unknown` instead of `any` for catch clause variables.

noUnusedLocals.description: Report errors on unused local variables.

noUnusedParameters.description: Report errors on unused function parameters.

noImplicitReturns.description: Report errors when not all code paths return a value.

noImplicitOverride.description: Require `override` on class members that override base members.

noFallthroughCasesInSwitch.description: Report errors for fallthrough cases in switch statements.

exactOptionalPropertyTypes.description: Interpret optional property types as written without implicit `undefined`.

noUncheckedIndexedAccess.description: Add `undefined` to index signature access results.

noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature.description: Disallow property access from index signatures without explicit index access.

noImprecisePrimitives.description: Require precise primitive types (int32 vs number, etc.).

noImplicitSelf.description: Require explicit `self.` for member access in methods.

noImplicitManagedType.description: Require `^T` or `&T` in type positions (no implicit managed types).

noImplicitManagedValue.description: Require explicit copy/borrow at call sites (no implicit managed values).

noManaged.description: Forbid managed runtime features entirely (no &T at all, pure value types only).

noRuntime.description: Forbid runtime entirely (no managed memory, no Promise, no exceptions, ...).

noDynamicShapes.description: Forbid defineProperty, prototype mutation, delete, and declaration expressions.

noComputedPropertyAccess.description: Forbid computed property access `obj[expr]` where expr isn't constant.

noImplicitDynamicDispatch.description: Require overloads to be statically resolvable (no implicit runtime dispatch).

borrowMode.description: Borrow checking mode for `&T` and `&mut T`.

rootDir.description: Root directory of source files (controls output directory structure, not module resolution).

declarationDir.description: Output directory for declaration files (.d.ts). Defaults to outDir.

tsconfig.description: Path to tsconfig.json to inherit settings from.

allowTs.description: Allow TypeScript files (.ts, .tsx) in the project.

allowJs.description: Allow JavaScript files (.js, .jsx) in the project.

skipLibCheck.description: Skip type checking of declaration files (.d.ts, .d.ds).

BorrowModeJson.description: Borrow checking mode for JSON deserialization.

DsConfigFormatterJson.description:
Formatter options (top-level, like Biome/Deno).

Field names use Prettier-compatible naming for familiarity.

indentWidth.description: Number of spaces per indent. Default: 4.

singleQuote.description: Use single quotes. Takes precedence over quoteStyle.

bracketSpacing.description: Spaces inside object braces: `{ foo }` (true) vs `{foo}` (false). Default: true.

bracketSameLine.description: Put `>` of multi-line JSX on same line as last attribute.

singleAttributePerLine.description: Force each JSX attribute onto its own line.

organizeImports.description: Whether to organize imports: "on" or "off". Default: off.

importSortOrder.description: Sort order for import specifiers: "natural" or "alphabetical". Default: natural.

LineEndingJson.description: Line ending style for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Use single quotes for single characters, double quotes for strings.

TrailingCommaJson.description: Trailing comma policy for JSON deserialization (Prettier: `trailingComma`).

oneOf.description: Trailing commas where valid in ES5.

ArrowParenthesesJson.description: Arrow function parentheses for JSON deserialization.

QuotePropertyJson.description: Object property quoting for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Quote all if any require quotes.
Organize imports: sort statements by group and specifiers alphabetically.
Natural sort: numbers ordered as integers (a1 < a2 < a10).

enabled.description: Whether linting is enabled. Default: true.

maxSwitchCases.description: Maximum switch cases per switch statement.

maxTypeVariants.description: Maximum variants in a union type or enum.

maxTypeFields.description: Maximum fields in a struct, class, or interface.

maxTypeComplexity.description: Maximum type complexity (nesting depth of generics/unions/intersections).

maxDuplicateStringOccurrences.description: Maximum occurrences of the same string literal before warning.

maxTryBlockStatements.description: Maximum statements in a try block.

recommended.description: Enable the recommended rule set (shorthand for preset: "recommended").

ArrayTypeStyleJson.description: Preferred array type syntax for the `array-type` rule.

TypeDefinitionStyleJson.description: Preferred type definition syntax for the `consistent-type-definitions` rule.

FilenameCaseJson.description: Filename case style for the `filename-case` rule.

CachePolicyJson.description: Cache eviction policy for JSON deserialization.

CacheValidateJson.description: Cache validation policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Validate only on mismatched metadata or changes.

CacheScopeJson.description: Cache scope selection for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Cache entries are stored in a global shared cache.

pollIntervalMs.description: Poll interval in milliseconds for polling watchers.

entry.description:
Entry points for entry-based discovery (bundled/executable targets).
If set, discovery mode is Entry; otherwise it's Include.

include.description: Glob patterns for files to include (for include-based discovery).

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude.

output.description: Output format (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, WebAssembly, Native).

runtime.description: Runtime environment (e.g., Browser, Node, Deno, Bun, Worker, Workerd).

runtimeVersion.description: Runtime version for selecting versioned libs.

platform.description: Target platform (e.g., Web, Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, WASI, BareMetal, Universal).

cpuFeatures.description: CPU feature flags for native codegen (e.g., "+sse4.2", "+aes").

outDir.description: Output directory for this target (overrides compilerOptions.outDir).

outFile.description: Output file for single-file targets like wasm (e.g., "./dist/core.wasm").

declarationDir.description: Separate directory for declaration files (overrides compilerOptions.declarationDir).

module.description: Module format for this target (overrides compilerOptions.module).

target.description: ECMAScript target for this target (overrides compilerOptions.target).

lib.description: Library files for this target (overrides derived libs).

types.description: Additional library types for this target.

profile.description: Explicit profile name for this target.

debug.description: Whether this is a debug build.

debugMode.description: Debug execution mode for VM/native targets.

safepointMode.description: Safepoint insertion mode for native execution.

safepointInterval.description: Instruction interval for safepoint polling (when enabled).

profilingMode.description: Profiling mode for tiering and optimization.

determinism.description: Determinism policy for runtime scheduling and I/O.

safetyPreset.description: Safety preset that configures runtime checks.

EmitArtifactJson.description: Extra artifacts to emit for JSON deserialization.

LtoModeJson.description: Link time optimization mode for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Choose mode based on optimization level.

FloatMathPolicyJson.description: Floating point math policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Enable fast math optimizations (assume no NaN, inf, or signed zero).

DebugInfoLevelJson.description: Debug info emission policy for JSON deserialization.

DebugModeJson.description: Debug execution mode for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Choose mode based on target debug settings.
Safepoints at calls, allocations, and loop back-edges.
Add instruction-budget safepoints for bounded latency.
Guarded speculations with explicit deopt metadata.
Replay external effects from the log.
Untrusted code with strict limits and validation.
Internal toolchain code with full privileges.
Forbid execution without an external sandbox.

StripLevelJson.description: Symbol stripping policy for JSON deserialization.

UnwindFormatJson.description: Unwind info format for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Debug safety mode with checks enabled.
Release mode with checks disabled and size focused settings.

OverflowCheckPolicyJson.description: Overflow checking policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Emit overflow checks only in debug builds.

BoundsCheckPolicyJson.description: Bounds check policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Emit bounds checks only in debug builds.

NullCheckPolicyJson.description: Null check policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Emit null checks only in debug builds.

DivisionCheckPolicyJson.description: Division check policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Emit division checks only in debug builds.

ShiftCheckPolicyJson.description: Shift range check policy for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Emit shift range checks only in debug builds.

CheckFailurePolicyJson.description: Check failure behavior for JSON deserialization.

oneOf.description: Trap immediately on a failed check.
Trigger a panic on a failed check.
Abort execution on a failed check.
Use a custom allocator provided by the runtime.

runtimeVersion.description: Runtime version for selecting versioned libs.

platform.description: Target platform (web, windows, macos, linux, ios, android, bare-metal, etc.).

types.description: Additional library types for this profile.

comptimeEnv.description: Comptime environment whitelist (if omitted, all env keys are visible).
